28          THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

[Photograph: Reproduction of a page from a catalog. Text reads:

FACULTY.

R. H. HALSELL, President,
And Professor of Mathematics and Latin.

E. H. PRITCHETT, Vice-President,
Distinguished Graduate and Medallist Virginia Military Institute. Professor of Applied Mathematics, French and German.

F. B. HIN-HAW, A. B., Treasurer,
And Professor of Education and Natural Science.

W. I. HUNT, A. B.,
Professor of Greek and Mental Science.

Tutor.
Music Teacher to be Supplied.]
notes: Printed page 28. Page is a reproduction of the Faculty page from a Savoy Literary College catalog. The name 'HIN-HAW' may be 'HINSHAW' with a line break in the original scan.
